page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne-c8d3.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs, which correspond to 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, and 128.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. A key hardware characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage configuration, which includes 70,866 GB of HDD storage. The server operates on a KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core workloads. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores falling in the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression rated as poor. However, multi-core performance is average, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, Passmark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core scores. Memory bandwidth is average for both small and large blocks, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

Given the older Intel Xeon architecture and HDD-based local storage, this server offers high resource density for storage-heavy workloads rather than high-performance compute. The massive 70,866 GB HDD capacity makes it highly cost-efficient for applications requiring vast local storage volumes where sequential access is acceptable and SSD speeds are not required. Appropriate workloads include large-scale data warehousing, cold storage, log processing, and distributed file systems that can leverage the 20 Gbps network bandwidth and multi-core processing capabilities.
